title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace: Just Flight F-15 Eagle & National Air Races drop! (don't buy twice!)
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 this week, or are you deciding which new Marketplace add-ons are actually worth your hard-earned cash? Today, we are breaking down a massive release drop—ranging from supersonic frontline air superiority and the iconic National Championship Air Races fleet to historic propliner liveries, utility helicopters, and even skiing in walkaround mode!

In this marketplace breakdown, we take a close look at features, panel variants, realistic expectations, and new releases across the MSFS 2024 virtual flight line:

✈️ JUST FLIGHT F-15 EAGLE (C/D/E/I/EX)
We kick things off with frontline air superiority. Just Flight brings their multi-variant F-15 Eagle family to MSFS 2024 as a full native aircraft built to 2024 operational specifications. We examine the native flight model with departure spin capabilities, 3D animated cockpit instrumentation, HUD, authentic night lighting, reflective rain effects, and custom afterburners across both free flight and world photographer modes.

🏁 NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP AIR RACES FLEET & CLASS PACKS
An absolute avalanche of racing legends hits the store! We break down the available aircraft across all four competition classes, available as individual planes, dedicated class packs, and complete bundles:
• Unlimited Class: P-51D Mustangs (Wee Willy II, Voodoo, Strega, Spam Can, Miss Virginia, Miss America, Moonbeam McSwine, Bunny, Lady B, Goldfinger).
• T-6 Class: T-6 Texan / AT-6 racers (Six Cat, Radial Velocity, Gunslinger, Big Red, Baron's Revenge, Baby Boomer, Almost Perfect, and more).
• Jet Class: Aero L-39 Albatros high-speed jets (Tumbler, Red Thunder, Pipsqueak, Drop Bear, American Spirit, American Patriot).
• Biplane Class: Aviat Pitts S-1S & S-2A aerobatic hot-rods (Smoking Hot, Second Hand, Razor X, Nice and EZ, Miss Diane, Panther).
⚠️ BUYER'S TIP: If you already own the Reno Air Races expansion in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020, check for your free upgrades before buying the new packages!

🎨 NEW LIVERY PACKS & HELICOPTER EXPANSIONS
Looking to refresh your existing hangar?
• F-111E Aardvark Livery Pack 1: Classic RAF, Tiger Meet, and research paint schemes.
• Redwing L-1049 Super Constellation Liveries: 14 crisp 4K real-world and novelty liveries (including KLM, Sabena, Trans Canada, and the Hogwarts Express).
• HRSimYard Airbus H125 Liveries: Dedicated Austrian Pack #1 and Swiss Pack #2 utility & police schemes.

🎿 BT STUDIO FREE RIDE (SKIING & SNOWBOARDING)
A unique twist for walkaround mode: BT Studio introduces winter sports down the alpine slopes of MSFS 2024. 

Which of these add-ons are you loading onto the flight line first? Taking the Just Flight F-15 Eagle to the ceiling, turning pylons in the Unlimited Class Mustangs, or hitting the slopes? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
